meta.title: Sign-up confirmed — Mobilcab
meta.description: Confirmation of your Mobilcab news signup.

ok.title: Done — you're subscribed to news.
ok.body: Thanks for confirming your address. You'll get product updates by email. This doesn't include the 20% Founding Partner discount — that program is separate.

error.linkTitle: This link is no longer valid
error.linkBody: The confirmation link has expired or is incomplete. Sign up again and we'll send you a new one.
error.serverBody: We couldn't confirm your sign-up. Please try the link in the email again in a few minutes.

referral.title: Invite other furniture makers
referral.body: For every furniture maker who signs up through your link and confirms their address, you move up the queue for the private beta. At {goal} confirmed invites, you get a guaranteed place in the beta.
referral.shareText: Here's a furniture design tool that runs straight from the browser. Sign up here:
referral.progress: {count} of {goal} confirmed invites — {left} more for a guaranteed beta place.
referral.done: {count} confirmed invites — your place in the private beta is guaranteed. We'll be in touch.
referral.note: You can come back here any time from the welcome email to check your progress. The names of the people you invite are never shown.
